description: This file implements an audio filter class 'AICFilter' using the ai-coustics AIC SDK for real-time audio enhancement within the Pipecat framework. It manages model initialization, parameter configuration, audio processing, and control frame handling.

classes.name: AICFilter
classes.description: An audio filter class that uses the ai-coustics AIC SDK to perform real-time audio enhancement, including model management, parameter setting, and audio processing.

methods.name: get_vad_factory
methods.description: Returns a factory function that creates a VAD instance bound to the AIC model.

methods.name: create_vad_analyzer
methods.description: Returns a lazily-initialized AICVADAnalyzer configured with optional parameters.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the AIC model with the given sample rate, configuring parameters and preparing for audio processing.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cleans up and closes the AIC model, clearing buffers.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes control frames to enable or disable filtering dynamically.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Processes incoming audio bytes, buffers them, and applies real-time enhancement using the AIC SDK, returning enhanced audio bytes.
